'''Corrsk''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Corrsk and fellow Trandoshan [[Dussk]] owned and operated the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] ''[[Riboga's Barge]]'', a [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]] that was formerly owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Riboga]]. The pair were openly disdainful of Riboga and Hutts in general, and when Riboga returned to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he sent the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Kills]] to [[Death/Legends|murder]] Corrsk and Dussk, to make an example of them.
